claims.text: MIC reports that the 26 newly elected members met on 20 December 2010 at a Special Meeting of the Legislative Assembly to elect the Prime Minister Designate by secret ballot. The Interim Speaker, Lord Tupou, read three nominations: Lord Tu'ivakano (nominated by Sunia Fili), and 'Akilisi Pohiva twice (nominated by 'Isileli Pulu and by Sitiveni Halapua). The ballot was to follow the members' speeches.
claims.uncertainty: A procedural record. It gives no result, and the ballot's own date (20 or 21 December) is not stated. The release was published on the government portal then served at pmo.gov.to (captured 30 November 2011).
